description:
HACKTOPUS is a premier 48-hour in-person hackathon organised by GDG On Campus GLA University. It brings together 600+ developers, designers, AI enthusiasts, and startup founders at GLA University, Mathura to build real projects from scratch.
WHY HACKTOPUS?
To give students and creators a high-energy environment where they can build without limits — with mentors, workshops, food, accommodation, and prizes all included. No excuses, just building.

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackTopus 2026 is a 48-hour national-level hackathon organized by GDG On Campus GLA University, bringing together developers, designers, and innovators to build impactful solutions and compete for exciting prizes.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is HackTopus 2026?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Students, developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts from all colleges and universities are welcome to participate.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Participation in HackTopus 2026 is completely free.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is there any registration fee?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. You can register individually, and we will provide opportunities for team formation before the hackathon begins.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I participate without a team?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Teams can have up to 4 members.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the maximum team size?

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackTopus 2026 is an offline, in-person hackathon hosted at GLA University, Mathura.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is the hackathon online or offline?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Participants can build projects across tracks such as AI/ML, Web Development, Open Source, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, Developer Tools, and Social Impact.
hackathon_faqs.question: What are the tracks for the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Participants should bring their laptops, chargers, student ID cards, and any hardware required for their projects.
hackathon_faqs.question: What should I bring to the event?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. Meals, refreshments, and basic facilities will be provided throughout the event.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will food and refreshments be provided?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, impact, design, scalability, and presentation.
hackathon_faqs.question: What are the judging criteria?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Absolutely! HackTopus welcomes participants of all skill levels. Mentors will be available throughout the event to help teams.
hackathon_faqs.question: Are beginners allowed to participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. All eligible participants will receive certificates of participation, and winners will receive additional recognition and prizes.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will participants receive certificates?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Project development must begin after the official hackathon kickoff. However, teams may brainstorm ideas beforehand.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can we start working on our project before the event?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Follow our official social media channels and join our community channels for announcements, workshops, and event updates.

hackathon_faqs.answer: Organizations interested in sponsorship or partnership opportunities can contact us at partnerships@gdgglau.org
